purpose: Teach: ありふれ/眠ら/怯え/おろそか/膨れ/太り/はいり/たたい

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんとのありふれた日常が宝だった
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, the ordinary days with Father… those were treasures.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze into memory. Slow, deliberate pacing. Breathe through the pause after 'treasures' — not sadness, but the weight of recognition. Voice trails slightly, as if still seeing it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、徹夜で眠らずに仕事された日もあったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, Grandpa — there were nights he'd work without sleeping, weren't there, dear?
lines.style: Warm affirmation, matching his memory. Gentle correction or gentle prompting — she's not arguing, she's standing beside him in the recollection. Soft, lilting on 'dear' at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが空襲に怯えながら家族を守られた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father stood guard against the air raids to keep us safe.
lines.style: Voice steadies with quiet reverence. The memory of fear is there but held at a distance now. Measured, almost ceremonial pacing. No tremor, but deep respect underneath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、家族との時間をおろそかにされなかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, he never neglected those precious moments with us, did he, dear?
lines.style: Affirming, slightly protective in tone. She's validating what he carried. Not a question really — a gentle insistence on the truth they both know. Soft landing on 'dear.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが餅でお腹を膨れさせて笑ってた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father would stuff his belly with mochi and laugh.
lines.style: A small smile enters the voice now — lighter, almost playful memory. Slower pace than the wistful lines, savoring the image. Warm exhale, like the joy is still there.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、晩年は少し太り気味だったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, in his later years he did fill out a bit, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Gentle teasing, affectionate. Not mocking — the tone of someone who loved watching him age, who noticed the softness that came. A small laugh hidden in her voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが古い家にはいり感慨に浸られた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, Father stepped into that old house and was lost in thought.
lines.style: The voice becomes almost contemplative, reverent. Pause before 'lost in thought' — honoring the moment of his reflection. Slower, gentler. The ordinary made sacred by memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、太鼓を優しくたたいて下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, you played the drum so tenderly for us, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Voice filled with quiet gratitude and love. Slower, almost a caress on 'tenderly.' This line holds her own memory, not just echoing his. Softer still, intimate close.
